messages.subject: Defective Tregarth bearings - need to take action
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Following our call, the board has approved instructing Whitfield Carter on the Tregarth bearing failures. We are now well over 30 pump failures and the recall is costing us serious money. Henry has the metallurgy in hand.

Can you send across an engagement letter and let us know next steps? We want to move quickly.

Grace

Grace Underwood
Group Finance Director
Pennington Industries Limited

messages.subject: RE: Defective Tregarth bearings - need to take action
messages.plaintextBody:
Grace,

Thank you - good to have the green light. Our engagement letter is attached. Tom Gallagher will lead day-to-day; I'll have overall conduct.

The immediate priorities are (1) firming up the metallurgical evidence and (2) getting a letter before action out to Tregarth. Please keep all failed bearings and your failure log preserved - they are key evidence.

Best,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner, Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
